lines.text: So. The hole in the hill eats you, spits you back, and Sophia says you bring things out of it.
Sometimes. If I get far enough.
Then get far enough. Winter doesn't care where the firewood comes from, and I don't care where the gold does. Can you fetch things from in there? Then fetch useful ones.
That's it? No questions about what it is?
When the roof leaks I don't interrogate the rain. Bring what the town can use. That's the whole speech.
